early_stop_rule: Reject the branch if the initial run and the single same-lineage extension fail the development behavior gates. Do not rescue it with attention-width, capacity, pointer-weight, loss-weight, decoder, or curriculum sweeps.

hypothesis.claim: Retaining contextual prompt token states directly and copying only exact source units will remove semantic-slot collapse and dense-pointer lexical blending while reducing decode work enough to preserve the CPU gate.
hypothesis.context_encoder: one encode-once bidirectional recurrent layer transferred from the closed semantic branch
hypothesis.decode_read: one width-32 query over at most 128 contextual token keys per generated unit
hypothesis.material_difference_from_closed_branch: The closed branch irreversibly compressed all contextual tokens into twelve learned slots and stored twelve dense vocabulary distributions. This branch retains bounded per-token context, removes learned slots, and scatters attention mass only to exact source token IDs.
hypothesis.sparse_copy: attention weights are scattered only onto observed prompt token IDs

promotion_rule: Only one integrated checkpoint lineage may supply quality, behavior, speed, TTFT, RSS, sparsity, incremental-state, and ABI evidence.
systems_optimization_rule: At most one profiler-directed runtime optimization, only after behavioral quality passes and speed or RSS is within 10 percent of its gate.

training_contract.curriculum: the frozen knowledge-light semantic-control v2 corpus
